updates.summary: Clinical trial results suggest an increased risk of atrial fibrillation for zoledronic acid (Aclasta▼), pamidronic acid, and possibly for alendronic acid, although the balance-risk remains favourable for bisphosphonates.

updates.title: Biosimilar products
updates.summary: A similar biological medicinal product (biosimilar) is a new biological product that has been developed to be similar to an existing biological product (“reference” product).

updates.title: Bevacizumab (Avastin): hypersensitivity and infusion reactions
updates.summary: Infusion reactions and hypersensitivity reactions have been reported commonly during treatment with Avastin.

updates.title: Bevacizumab and sunitinib: risk of osteonecrosis of the jaw
updates.summary: Dental examination and appropriate preventive dentistry should be considered before treatment with bevacizumab or sunitinib.

updates.title: Becaplermin (Regranex) for diabetic ulcers
updates.summary: Contraindicated in patients with any known current cancer

updates.title: Basiliximab: indicated for renal transplantation only; efficacy and safety not shown in heart transplantation
updates.summary: Basiliximab (Simulect) is indicated for preventing acute organ rejection only for allogeneic renal transplantation in patients receiving organ transplantation for the first time.

updates.title: Atypical (second-generation) antipsychotics
updates.summary: Reminder to monitor and manage weight, glucose, and lipid levels.

updates.title: Atomoxetine (Strattera▼): increases in blood pressure and heart rate
updates.summary: New contraindications, warnings, and advice for monitoring.

updates.title: Atomoxetine: risk of psychotic or manic symptoms in children and adolescents
updates.summary: Atomoxetine is associated with treatment-emergent psychotic or manic symptoms in children and adolescents - consider stopping this if symptoms occur.

updates.title: Aqueous cream: may cause skin irritation
updates.summary: May cause skin irritation, particularly in children with eczema, possibly due to sodium lauryl sulfate content.

updates.title: Aqueous calamine cream: do not use before X-ray examination
updates.summary: Don't apply aqueous calamine cream onto the skin before an X-ray examination because it may affect the outcome of the radiograph.

updates.title: Antipsychotics: risk of venous thromboembolic events
updates.summary: Use of Antipsychotic may be associated with an increased risk of venous thromboembolic events.

updates.title: Antipsychotics: risk of extrapyramidal effects or withdrawal symptoms in newborns
updates.summary: Risk of extrapyramidal effects or withdrawal symptoms (or both) in newborns after maternal use of antipsychotics during the third trimester of pregnancy.

updates.title: Antipsychotics: initiative to reduce prescribing to older people with dementia
updates.summary: Concerns over recent years about the use of antipsychotics to treat the behavioural and psychological symptoms of dementia (BPSD).

updates.title: Antiepileptics: risk of suicidal thoughts and behaviour
updates.summary: Antiepileptic treatment is associated with a small risk of suicidal thoughts and behaviour.

updates.title: Antiepileptics: adverse effects on bone
updates.summary: Data suggests that long-term use of carbamazepine, phenytoin, primidone, and sodium valproate is associated with decreased bone mineral density that may lead to osteopenia, osteoporosis, and increased fractures.

updates.title: Antiepileptic drugs: new advice on switching between different manufacturers’ products for a particular drug
updates.summary: Different antiepileptic drugs (AEDs) vary considerably in their characteristics, which influences the risk of whether switching between different manufacturers’ products of a particular drug may cause adverse effects or loss of seizure control. AEDs have been divided into three risk-based categories to help healthcare professionals decide whether it is necessary to maintain continuity of supply of a specific manufacturer’s product

updates.title: Antidepressants: suicidal thoughts and behaviour
updates.summary: Summary report on the risk of suicidal thoughts and behaviour related to antidepressants.

updates.title: Antidepressants: risk of fractures
updates.summary: Healthcare professionals should be aware of epidemiological data showing a small increased risk of fractures associated with the use of TCAs and SSRIs, and should take this risk into account in their discussions with patients and in prescribing decisions

updates.title: Angiotensin II receptor antagonists: evidence does not suggest any link with cancer
updates.summary: Evidence does not support any increased risk of cancer in patients who use these medicines.

updates.title: Aliskiren (Rasilez▼): risk of cardiovascular and renal adverse reactions
updates.summary: New contraindications and warnings for combination of aliskiren (Rasilez) with angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors or angiotensin receptor blockers (ARBs).

updates.title: Aliskiren (Rasilez▼): risk of angioedema and renal dysfunction
updates.summary: Use of aliskiren can cause angioedema, a rare and serious side effect, and or acute renal failure.

updates.title: Agomelatine (Valdoxan/ Thymanax): risk of dose-related hepatotoxicity and liver failure
updates.summary: Liver function tests should be carried out at treatment initiation, during treatment, and also when the dose is increased.

updates.title: Agomelatine (Valdoxan): risk of liver toxicity
updates.summary: Reminder to test liver function before and during treatment.

updates.title: Adrenaline auto-injector advice for patients
updates.summary: After every use, an ambulance should be called even if symptoms are improving, the individual should lie down with legs raised and, if at all possible, should not be left alone.

updates.title: Addiction to benzodiazepines and codeine
updates.summary: Supporting safer use

updates.title: ACE inhibitors and angiotensin II receptor antagonists: recommendations on how to use for breastfeeding
updates.summary: Mothers who are breastfeeding should not take ACE inhibitors or angiotensin II receptor antagonists in the first few weeks after delivery.

updates.title: ACE inhibitors and angiotensin II receptor antagonists: not for use in pregnancy
updates.summary: Use in women who are planning pregnancy should be avoided unless absolutely necessary, in which case the potential risks and benefits should be discussed

updates.title: Abraxane (paclitaxel, formulated as albumin-bound nanoparticles): potential presence of strands in intravenous infusion bag
updates.summary: If thin, translucent or white-to-yellow proteinaceous strands (1–2 mm in length) are visible, filtration is advised.

updates.title: Abacavir: risk of myocardial infarction—update from epidemiological studies
updates.summary: Abacavir should be used in line with current treatment guidelines and with caution in patients with high cardiovascular risk factors.

updates.title: ‘First Steps’ infant medicine feeder: recall due to overdose risk
updates.summary: Use of has led to serious paracetamol overdose in a 6-month-old infant.

updates.title: (Dextro)propoxyphene: new studies confirm cardiac risks
updates.summary: (Dextro)propoxyphene can have serious effects on the electrical activity of the heart (resulting in prolongation of the P-R and Q-T intervals, and widened QRS complexes), even at normal therapeutic doses.

updates.title: α-1 adrenoreceptor antagonists: intraoperative floppy iris syndrome (IFIS)
updates.summary: Cataract surgeons should check past or current use of α-1 adrenoreceptor antagonists for prostatic hypertrophy before surgery.

updates.title: Aspirin: not licensed for primary prevention of thrombotic vascular disease
updates.summary: In the UK, low-dose aspirin is licensed for prevention of thrombotic cerebrovascular or cardiovascular disease only in those who already have vascular disease—ie, secondary prevention.
